tei:div.tei:p: (pha)༄༅// a rog che la gnang ba'i bkra shis bzhugs// ༄༅// oṃ swa sti siddhaṃ/ rnam 'dren bla ma mchog dang dkon mchog dang*// lha mchog rnams dang sngags dang grub pa'i rdzongs// bkra shis yid 'ong 'byung gnas thams cad kyi// bkra shis dam pa khyed la sbyin gyur cig /shar gyi phyogs su nyon mongs kun bskyod pa'i// zhing du bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas rjes spyod kyi// 'khor dang bcas pa'i bkra shis phun tshogs kyis// rgyal sras 'khor bcas shar du bde legs shog /lho phyogs mun pa bcom pa sems bskyed pa// yid mdzad bsnyengs bral mngon 'phags rgyal po ni// 'khor dang bcas pa'i bkra shis phun tshogs kyis// rgyal sras 'khor bcas lho ru bde legs shog /nub kyi phyogs kyi 'jig rten yul phebs par// thub pa 'khon dang rgyags pa rnam gnon ni// 'khor dang bcas pa'i bkra shis phun tshogs kyis// rgyal sras 'khor bcas nub tu bde legs shog /byang phyogs sangs rgyas spobs pa can zhes byar// bde gshegs rin chen gzugs bkod 'od gnon ni// 'khor dang bcas pa'i bkra shis phun tshogs kyis// rgyal sras 'khor bcas byang du bde legs shog /byang shar bdud kyi sde bcom zhes bya bar// bdud dang yid gnyis kun 'joms rnam gnon pa// 'khor dang bcas pa'i bkra shis phun tshogs kyis// rgyal sras byang shar phyogs su bde legs shog /shar lho rtag tu snang ba'i 'jig rten du// dang po sems bskyed phyir mi ldog pa yi// 'khor lo 'byung dpal 'khor bcas bkra shis kyis// rgyal sras shar lho phyogs su bde legs shog /lho nub gser gyi dra bas g.yogs pa ru// bde gshegs rin chen gdugs 'phags snang ba ni// 'khor dang bcas pa'i bkra shis phun tshogs kyis// rgyal sras 'khor bcas lho nub bde legs shog /nub byang yongs dag rab gnas mngon 'phags par// bcom ldan byang chub sems dpa' 'dul ba ni// 'khor dang bcas pa'i bkra shis phun tshogs kyis// rgyal sras 'khor bcas nub byang bde legs shog

/steng phyogs dmigs med yid la byed par ni// skrag med mun bral ting 'dzin mngon 'phags rgyal// 'khor dang bcas pa'i bkra shis phun tshogs kyis// rgyal sras 'khor bcas kun du bde legs shog /'og phyogs yon tan kun gyis brgyan pa ru// dang po sems bskyed the tshom gcod mdzad pa// nyon mongs bskyod pa 'khor bcas bkra shis kyis// rgyal sras 'khor bcas kun du bde legs shog /dbus kyi zhing khams mi mjed 'di nyid du// ston pa skyob pa shākya thub pa ni// 'khor dang bcas pa'i bkra shis phun tshogs kyis// rgyal sras gnas dus kun du bde legs shog /de ltar bkra shis phun tshogs thams cad kyis// shis pas rgyal bu khyod la shis bya'i phyir// dge slong 'phags pa zhes byas nyer bsdebs nas// rgyal bu a rog che la phul ba lags// me pho byi ba'i lo gsar pa bkra shis par bya ba'i phyir/ phyogs bcu mun pa rnams par sel ba'i mdo'i rjes su 'brang ba'i bkra shis kyi tshigs du bcad pa rnam par spel ba 'di/ shing mo phag gi lo rgyal gyi zla ba tshes nyi shu gcig gi nyin par dpal sa skya'i gtsug lag khang du sbyar ba'o// oṃ su pra tiṣṭha badzre swā hā// // ༈ gu rus dpar rtsa spel ba'o//
